Description: Source files carrying at least 30 distinct definitions — a 'god file' detector with an ABSOLUTE threshold, so a file's verdict depends only on that file. The threshold was corpus-relative until mache-ce0bcd (n >= 10 AND n > 3x the project mean), which coupled every file's verdict to every other file and inverted the incentive the rule exists to create: deleting a god file, or splitting one into five — the canonical fix — lowers the mean, lowers the bar, and fails the gate on unrelated files the change never touched. Measured on mache itself, three files sat 0.10 definitions under the bar, and two new 5-definition files anywhere in the repo flipped all three on. An absolute threshold is also the only kind a committed ratchet baseline can hold, because a relative one silently re-draws which files are grandfathered every time the corpus moves. 30 is calibrated to reproduce mache's own findings exactly at the moment of the switch — a judgement call, not a law — and is meant to be tuned per project via --min-metric or a rules-dir override. Counts DISTINCT definition tokens, not lines: a file of 30 one-line accessors is the sprawl this looks for; a long file holding one type is not. Generated (*.capnp.go, *.pb.go, *_generated.go, *.gen.go), test, and vendored files are excluded as noise.
Query:
-- Resolve source_file via leaf children when the dir
			-- itself has none. The schema engine attaches Origin
			-- (and thus source_file) to leaf rendered files (source,
			-- ast.json, doc) but not to the wrapping construct dir.
			-- Without this fallback per_file groups by '' (empty)
			-- and produces zero rows on the FCA-inferred path.
			WITH child_source AS (
				SELECT parent_id AS node_id,
				       MIN(source_file) AS source_file
				FROM nodes
				WHERE source_file IS NOT NULL AND source_file != ''
				GROUP BY parent_id
			),
			resolved_defs AS (
				SELECT d.token,
				       COALESCE(NULLIF(n.source_file, ''), cs.source_file) AS file
				FROM v_defs d
				JOIN nodes n ON n.id = d.node_id
				LEFT JOIN child_source cs ON cs.node_id = n.id
			),
			per_file AS (
				SELECT file, COUNT(DISTINCT token) AS n
				FROM resolved_defs
				WHERE COALESCE(file, '') != ''
				  -- Non-owned and generated files are excluded from the
				  -- REPORT. They were also kept out of a project mean; there
				  -- is no mean any more (mache-ce0bcd), so this is now only
				  -- about not filing findings nobody is going to fix.
				  AND file NOT LIKE '%%.capnp.go'
				  AND file NOT LIKE '%%.pb.go'
				  AND file NOT LIKE '%%_generated.go'
				  AND file NOT LIKE '%%.gen.go'
				  AND file NOT LIKE '%%_test.go'
				  -- Vendored corpus (ADR-0019 snapshots) is checked in to be
				  -- PARSED, not maintained: nobody refactors it, so findings
				  -- there are noise (mache-f41b43). While the threshold was
				  -- corpus-relative this exclusion also protected the BAR,
				  -- which was the larger effect; an absolute threshold has no
				  -- bar to protect, so this is back to being a plain noise
				  -- filter. v_vendored_files is the single definition of
				  -- vendored-ness.
				  AND file NOT IN (SELECT source_file FROM v_vendored_files)
				GROUP BY file
			)

			SELECT pf.file AS source_id,
			       '' AS node_id,
			       0 AS start_byte,
			       0 AS end_byte,
			       0 AS start_row,
			       0 AS start_col,
			       pf.n AS metric
			FROM per_file pf
			WHERE pf.n >= 10
			%s
			ORDER BY metric DESC, source_id
